question: Which use of curly braces does NOT work in JSX?
say: Which use of curly braces does not work in JSX?
explanation: Curlies work only as text inside a tag or as an attribute value after =. They cannot be used as a tag name.
explainSay: Using curly braces as the tag name. They only work as text inside a tag, or as an attribute value after the equals sign.
